title: LAE Auto Electrician – Heavy Vehicle
description:
Position: Auto Electrician – Heavy Vehicle
Department: Workshop
We are looking to hire a skilled auto electrician specialise in heavy vehicles to work in our busy workshop. Duties will include installing, and repairing electrical wiring, diagnosing problems with vehicle electrical systems, repairing damaged electrical parts, and maintaining electrical equipment.
To ensure success as an auto electrician, you should have extensive knowledge and a good eye for detail and be able to problem-solve complex electrical problems. Ultimately, a top-notch auto electrician can install, troubleshoot, and repair any electrical system in vehicle.
Main Responsibilities:
Diagnostic and fault tracing of a varied range of our fleet
Gathering information from driver about issues with their electrical system
Repairing and replacing faulty wiring or electrical systems
Servicing of electrical automotive parts
Maintaining a clean working environment
Highly safety focused on all times and take a personal responsibility for safety of others
Ensure all documentation is completed and returned for costing in a timely manner
Perform other task that may assign from time to time
Requirements:
Diploma or relevant Certificate/Trade qualifications
Police clearance & medical certificate
3-5 years proven work experience as an auto electrician – commercial heavy vehicles
References from reputable employers
Complex problem-solving skills
Ability to operate electrical diagnostic equipment
Excellent physical condition and coordination
Honest, reliable, and great work ethic
Able to work under pressure, overtime and withstand harsh environment
Able to participate in workplace safety
Speak, read and write in English
Experience in the freight industry is a plus
This position is available for immediate start with conditions commensurate with experience. If this sounds like you, please submit your application to this email address:
